title: Countable cover of {DF ≠ 0} by C¹ straightening charts Ψ_q with F∘Ψ_q = first coordinate
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and F : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ be C¹. Then there are sets B_q ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} and maps Ψ_q : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^{n+1} (q ∈ ℕ) such that for every q: B_q is open; Ψ_q is C¹ on B_q and injective on B_q; the derivative DΨ_q(w) = fderiv ℝ Ψ_q w is bijective for every w ∈ B_q; F(Ψ_q(w)) = w(0) (the 0-th coordinate of w) for every w ∈ B_q; Ψ_q(B_q) is open; and {y ∈ ℝ^{n+1} : DF(y) ≠ 0} ⊆ ⋃_q Ψ_q(B_q).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 F → ∃ (B : ℕ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (Ψ : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)), (∀ q, IsOpen (B q)) ∧ (∀ q, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Ψ q) (B q)) ∧ (∀ q, InjOn (Ψ q) (B q)) ∧ (∀ q, ∀ w ∈ B q, Bijective (fderiv ℝ (Ψ q) w)) ∧ (∀ q, ∀ w ∈ B q, F (Ψ q w) = w 0) ∧ (∀ q, IsOpen (Ψ q '' B q)) ∧ {y | fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0} ⊆ ⋃ q, Ψ q '' B q
